objective: Define the closed provider-neutral ChangeIntegration artifacts, module surface, and integration adapter port.

forbiddenActions: Do not implement repository mutation, target CAS, local Git adapter behavior, checkpoint recovery, result normalization, traceability, SystemVerification, or BusinessAcceptance.
Do not change package metadata, exports, baselines, dogfood gate artifacts, unrelated modules, or shared generic Core behavior.
Do not create approval, verification, integration, graph, or progression facts.
Do not create commits, tags, pull requests, or merge any branch.

contractRequirements.successBoundary: IntegratedChangeRecord proves repository incorporation only and cannot assert SystemVerification or BusinessAcceptance.

verificationPlan: Compile every schema through the repository's generic Ajv helper.
Exercise positive, negative, unknown-field, forbidden-authority, and adapter-substitution fixtures.
Run the focused contract suite, generic module-contract suite, schema-enforcement suite, Node syntax check, and scoped git diff check.

requiredEvidence.description: Only closed provider-neutral ChangeIntegration artifacts validate and the adapter port exposes no upstream or downstream authority.

handoffContract.format: Return one exact JSON object in the final response with fields workItemId, outcome, summary, changedFiles, verification, deliverables, sourceRefs, residualRisks, and integrationNotes.
